summary: No new role cleared every hard gate. Hugging Face Voice Agents and Dust AI Support offer equity but no numerical cash-base floor. Cohere Training Infra publishes only North American pay tiers. n8n Agentic Engineering does not establish France eligibility or a French pay tier; Qonto Android has unresolved AI-primary scope and compensation. Thunderbird is excluded on geography. Five near-misses and one exclusion are research leads, not recommendations.
coverage: Fourteen official employer boards retrieved from fifteen attempted aliases: Dust, Qonto, n8n, Hugging Face, Grafana Labs, Elastic, Mozilla, poolside, Modal, LangChain, Cohere, Photoroom, Exa and Lovable. Six roles and six rendered application forms examined in detail and exported below; additional board/discovery leads are not individually verified recommendations. Coverage is bounded, not exhaustive.
criteria: Paris hybrid with explicit attendance, or fully remote explicitly allowing France-based applicants.
Senior/staff hands-on AI-central engineering; an AI employer, coding assistant use or AI product UI alone does not establish the required assignment.

Employer-published annual gross cash-base lower bound strictly above €100,000, or at least €80,000 with explicit equity. Use the lower bound; equity is not cash; packages, OTE and estimates do not pass.
No unchanged prior selections. Requisition identity takes precedence over refreshed titles, URLs or timestamps; historical qualification is not current-live verification.
uncertainty: Sources checked October 17, 2026. Posting dates use employer publication metadata, not claims of newly created or newly discovered vacancies.

Fourteen retrieved boards are discovery coverage, not fourteen verified listings. The attempted mistral Ashby alias returned 404; this does not establish no Mistral vacancies. Web extraction was unavailable; direct official retrieval and browser rendering were used.

Deduplication covers accessible October 10–16 reports and supplied October 3/5 Escape selection history. Original October 3/5 reports were not accessible in this checkout; complete earlier-history novelty is not claimed. Prior Pigment, DualEntry and Escape picks were not recycled.
Unpublished or France-inapplicable pay is marked unknown, not below threshold. No foreign-currency threshold conversion was made because no foreign pay band was established as a French offer.
Dust has an On-site header, occasional home-working in its description and a four-office-day application question. The stricter application expectation is retained; no flexible schedule is inferred.

Qonto’s remote option is an application preference subject to discussion. n8n lacks explicit France role eligibility and named senior/staff grade; Cohere likewise does not name its exact grade. None is ranked.

No role advanced to separate company/product diligence. Funding, financial condition, employee size and recent material activity are not publicly verified in this run; listing-derived context is not independent product verification.
decision: No approval needed for this authorized daily website update. No newly qualifying application is recommended. Any near-miss requires its stated missing pay, France eligibility, level or work-scope evidence before reconsideration. No applications or outreach were made.
